description: This file defines classes and functions for monitoring and intercepting network requests in Firefox, including handling request lifecycle events, request interception, response storage, and security details, as part of the Playwright project.

classes.name: PageNetwork
classes.description: Manages network requests and responses for a specific page target, including request interception and response storage.

classes.name: NetworkRequest
classes.description: Represents an individual network request, handling interception, response data collection, and event emission.

classes.name: NetworkObserver
classes.description: Observes and manages network activity, redirects, and request lifecycle events in Firefox.

classes.name: ResponseStorage
classes.description: Stores response bodies with size limits, providing base64-encoded responses.

methods.name: PageNetwork.forPageTarget
methods.description: Returns or creates a PageNetwork instance for a given target.

methods.name: PageNetwork.setExtraHTTPHeaders
methods.description: Sets additional HTTP headers for requests.

methods.name: PageNetwork.combinedExtraHTTPHeaders
methods.description: Returns combined extra HTTP headers from target and instance.

methods.name: PageNetwork.enableRequestInterception
methods.description: Enables request interception.

methods.name: PageNetwork.disableRequestInterception
methods.description: Disables request interception and resumes intercepted requests.

methods.name: PageNetwork.resumeInterceptedRequest
methods.description: Resumes a intercepted request with specified parameters.

methods.name: PageNetwork.fulfillInterceptedRequest
methods.description: Fulfills an intercepted request with specified response data.

methods.name: PageNetwork.abortInterceptedRequest
methods.description: Aborts an intercepted request.

methods.name: PageNetwork.getResponseBody
methods.description: Retrieves the response body for a request as base64.

methods.name: NetworkRequest.resume
methods.description: Resumes a request with optional URL, method, headers, and postData.

methods.name: NetworkRequest.abort
methods.description: Aborts a request with an error code.

methods.name: NetworkRequest.fulfill
methods.description: Fulfills a request with specified status, headers, and body.

methods.name: NetworkRequest._onInternalRedirect
methods.description: Handles internal redirect of a request.

methods.name: NetworkRequest._onInternalRedirectReady
methods.description: Prepares a request after a resumed internal redirect.

methods.name: NetworkRequest.getInterface
methods.description: Provides interfaces for authentication and interception control.

methods.name: NetworkRequest.getAuthPrompt
methods.description: Returns the auth prompt interface.

methods.name: NetworkRequest.asyncPromptAuth
methods.description: Asynchronously prompts for authentication.

methods.name: NetworkRequest.promptAuth
methods.description: Provides credentials for authentication if available.

methods.name: NetworkRequest.shouldPrepareForIntercept
methods.description: Determines if a request should be prepared for interception.

methods.name: NetworkRequest.channelIntercepted
methods.description: Handles intercepted channel and possibly yields to service worker.

methods.name: NetworkRequest.onDataAvailable
methods.description: Handles incoming data chunks for a request.

methods.name: NetworkRequest.onStartRequest
methods.description: Handles start of request.

methods.name: NetworkRequest.onStopRequest
methods.description: Handles end of request, storing response or error.

methods.name: NetworkObserver._onRedirect
methods.description: Handles HTTP redirect events.

methods.name: NetworkObserver._onRequest
methods.description: Handles new request events.

methods.name: NetworkObserver._onResponse
methods.description: Handles response events.

methods.name: NetworkObserver._onServiceWorkerResponse
methods.description: Handles responses fulfilled by service worker.

methods.name: getSecurityDetails
methods.description: Extracts security info from an HTTP channel.

methods.name: readRequestPostData
methods.description: Reads POST data from an HTTP channel.

methods.name: requestHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves request headers from an HTTP channel.

methods.name: clearRequestHeaders
methods.description: Removes request headers from an HTTP channel.

methods.name: overrideRequestHeaders
methods.description: Overrides request headers on an HTTP channel.

methods.name: filterHeadersForRedirect
methods.description: Filters headers according to redirect rules.

methods.name: causeTypeToString
methods.description: Converts cause type constants to string labels.

methods.name: appendExtraHTTPHeaders
methods.description: Appends extra headers to an HTTP channel.

methods.name: ResponseStorage.addResponseBody
methods.description: Stores response body with size management.

methods.name: ResponseStorage.getBase64EncodedResponse
methods.description: Retrieves response body as base64, uncompressing if needed.

methods.name: responseHead
methods.description: Extracts response status, headers, and status text.

methods.name: setPostData
methods.description: Sets POST data on an HTTP channel.

methods.name: convertString
methods.description: Converts string encoding via stream conversion.
